record.summary: A `Spec-Drift-Waiver:` line clears every refusal in the pull request it appears in, once, with no scope, no expiry and no record. This adds a declared lifecycle evaluated over caller-supplied inputs: scope, an as-of time, an ancestry, and a usage count the caller provides. No counter in an authored file and no atomic consumption. Deferred: specified now, built when a consumer names the need.
